name: Functional magnetic resonance imaging
description: Measures the blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) signal as an indirect, haemodynamic index of neural activity, at rest or during tasks.

name: Structural magnetic resonance imaging
description: Anatomical imaging used for morphometry — regional volume, cortical thickness, and surface area — and for detecting structural change over time.

name: Electroencephalography
description: Scalp recording of electrical potentials generated by synchronized neuronal populations; supports spectral, event-related, and connectivity analyses.
spatialResolution: centimetres at scalp level; source localization is model-dependent

name: Transcranial magnetic stimulation
description: Non-invasive brain stimulation using induced magnetic fields to probe or modulate cortical excitability; used experimentally and therapeutically.
